description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams class which extends FilterParams. It includes properties and methods to set and get search filter parameters, such as employee number, for employee skill search functionality. It also specifies allowed sort fields and initializes default sort criteria.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for specifying search filter parameters related to employee skills, including filtering by employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of EmployeeSkillSearchFilterParams, setting the default sort field to 's.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, which can be null or an integer.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter, accepting a nullable integer.
